McKowski DJ Night - Sound of Belfast 2026

  • Wednesday 11 November 2026 22:00
    Thursday 12 November 2026 02:00
  • Google Calendar ICS

Join us at The Harrison Chambers of Distinction for a late-night DJ set with McKowski, as part of the Sound of Belfast Festival 2026.

Celebrating Belfast’s rich musical heritage and its status as a UNESCO City of Music, this special event brings together Harrison residents and friends for a relaxed evening of great music and good company.

Come along, unwind and soak up the sounds of Belfast as we celebrate the city’s vibrant music scene.

Free Entry!
